dataset: EIA Form 930 hourly balancing authority operations (PUDL out_eia930__hourly_operations)
timestamp_convention: UTC, hour-ending (PUDL: 'Timestamp at the end of the hour')
units: MWh per hour (equivalent to average MW)

variables.datetime_utc: Date and time converted to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
variables.balancing_authority_code_eia: EIA short code identifying a balancing authority. May include Canadian and Mexican BAs.
variables.net_generation_reported_mwh: Unaltered originally reported net generation for the specified period.
variables.net_generation_adjusted_mwh: Reported net generation adjusted by EIA to reflect non-physical commercial transfers through pseudo-ties and dynamic scheduling.
variables.net_generation_imputed_eia_mwh: Reported net generation with outlying values removed and missing values imputed by EIA.
variables.interchange_reported_mwh: Original reported energy interchange between adjacent balancing authorities.
variables.interchange_adjusted_mwh: Energy interchange between adjacent balancing authorities, adjusted by EIA to reflect non-physical commercial transfers through pseudo-ties and dynamic scheduling.
variables.interchange_imputed_eia_mwh: Energy interchange between adjacent balancing authorities, with outliers and missing values imputed by EIA.
variables.demand_reported_mwh: Originally reported electricity demand, calculated by taking the net generation within the BA and subtracting the interchange with adjacent BAs.
variables.demand_adjusted_mwh: Electricity demand adjusted by EIA to reflect non-physical commercial transfers through pseudo-ties and dynamic scheduling.
variables.demand_imputed_pudl_mwh: Electricity demand calculated by subtracting BA interchange from net generation, with outliers and missing values imputed in PUDL.
variables.demand_imputed_pudl_mwh_imputation_code: Code describing why a demand value was flagged for imputation.
variables.demand_imputed_eia_mwh: Electricity demand calculated by subtracting BA interchange from net generation, with outliers and missing values imputed by EIA.
